name: jig
description: Jig — a personal agentic workbench around Claude Code that builds its own tools.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/sdk && tsc -p packages/azure && tsc -p packages/themes && tsc -p packages/learning && tsc -p packages/documents && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc -p addons && tsc -p relay/teams
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:decisions
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:tokens && npm run check:decisions
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace @jig/desktop
